meaning.pt-BR: O excesso relativo com que a série de Fourier ultrapassa um salto: a integral do seno cardinal de 0 a π, dividida por π, menos meio. Vale cerca de 0,0895, isto é, cerca de 9 % da altura do salto, qualquer que seja a função descontínua.
meaning.en: The relative amount by which the Fourier series overshoots a jump: the integral of the cardinal sine from 0 to π, divided by π, minus one half. It is about 0.0895, that is, about 9% of the height of the jump, whatever the discontinuous function.

spoken.pt-BR: Um sobre pi vezes a integral, de zero a pi, de seno de u sobre u, d u, menos um meio.
spoken.en: One over pi times the integral, from zero to pi, of sine of u over u, d u, minus one half.

text.en: half the height of the jump
